title: Mixed Event — Secret Distance — Episode3 Time for a Mystery Tour!

meta.Episode: Episode3 — Time for a Mystery Tour!
meta.Event Outline: In hopes of pulling Kanade out of her songwriting slump, Mizuki plans a mystery tour for a much-needed change of pace. And so begins Nightcord at 25:00's first ever day trip together...

rows.Line: The day of the mystery tour

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, there they are!
Heeey! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Yawn*... So sleepy...
How can you have this much energy this early?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning, Mafuyu! Looks like everyone's right on time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So let's get this show on the road♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just where exactly are you taking us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It'd sorta stop being a mystery tour if I told you, wouldn't it? You'll just have to wait and find out♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We've been on this thing for an eternity...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can't you just tell us where we're going already? All I see are farms and rice paddies now. Are we going into the mountains or something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Patience is a virtue, Ena.
You should be trying to imagine what sort of fun-filled adventure I have in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But we're almost there...
Maybe this is a good time to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, finally. You've already made us wait this long.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We'll be checking out a haunted area that everyone's been talking about♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Relax. There's a reason I picked this place.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember how I met Ena's li'l bro during the School Festival?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: His class did a haunted house that time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I thought a little test of courage might do us some good♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But the truth is that you just want to go, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's another way to put it☆

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If it'll help Kanade with her music, I don't think where we go matters.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for putting you all through this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, Kanade, don't say that!
Blame Mizuki for dragging us all the way out here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's totally okay!
I've sort of been wanting to go on a trip with everyone like this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And relax, Ena!
This place might be haunted, but there's supposed to be a ton of good photo ops too♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's not what I have a problem with!!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This place... I'm starting to get a bad feeling...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, are we gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Perfect! This place really doesn't disappoint!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This spot in particular seems to be pretty famous. They say that a bunch of accidents and stuff keep happening here because people keep seeing ghosts!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, here's that hole they were talking about. Apparently, a car crashed right into here. Pretty eerie...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...? So you're saying that a ghost made that crash happen...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um...
If we're doing a horror theme...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The intro can include a double bass, people screaming in a few places and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: S-See! It won't really help her! We don't have to go in!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do you think that song can save anyone?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Geez, this tunnel's so long...
It's the middle of the day, but pitch black in here...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. They say that the ghost here is of a woman with really long hair...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They say that she looks like a regular person, so people end up asking her if something's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She apparently mumbles some stuff and these people always end up trying to hear what she's saying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the ones who heard her speak all ended up...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! What do you mean, Who Knows?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And why are you telling us that in a place like this?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha. Okay, sorry.
We'll be fine. I promise.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It ran off in that direction.
It kicked the can and made it rattle.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*... Just a tanuki?
I got worked up over nothing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You should've seen the look on your face...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Where's Kanade?
She was right next to me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, are you sure?
Heeey! Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
She's not responding...
Where'd she go?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She might be lost. We can't just leave her like this! I'll go look while you two head for the exit!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What do I do...?
But the exit's right here, so as long as I can make it there...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Eep!
Oh, nevermind. It was just a leaf...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Is someone there?
Mizuki and Mafuyu went the other way so...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, Th-The Pain...?
No, is this what Mizuki was...?!
